title: eucalyptus ceratocorys
intro: Eucalyptus ceratocorys, commonly known as the rough-fruited mallee, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in relieving respiratory issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Eucalyptus ceratocorys include decongestant and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and sore muscles. The bioactive constituents of this plant include eucalyptol, a key compound responsible for its medicinal properties, which also contribute to its antiseptic and antispasmodic actions.
